en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a wide, tree‑lined boulevard crowded with pedestrians and a few horse‑drawn vehicles. Multi‑story European‑style buildings line both sides of the street, and low hills or a citadel appear in the background. The right side margin contains printed French text reading "Souvenir de Salonique," while the bottom caption identifies the scene as "Salonique, Boulevard Hamidie." The rest of the front is heavily covered with handwritten cursive text.
